provenance: Assistant-authored synthetic development cases, reviewed individually against EMS fields during stage 5. Not independently human-annotated and not a gold standard. No model or ranking parameters tuned on these cases.
scope: Literal controlled-term mention detection (concept ID and original character span), not document topic relevance.
